name: Case law: United States, the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit
label: United States case law (the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit)
coverage: 24191 published opinions with text, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 8864 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)
